verdict.rationale: Column's docs say developers can programmatically open and manage FDIC-insured bank accounts on behalf of customers, including FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types, which covers per-customer accounts and an FBO master structure. A community commenter confirms you can create multiple account numbers pointing to a single bank account, each with its own permissions and limits, which is the virtual-account pattern. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a master/sub-account hierarchy, evidence of virtual accounts being used for reconciliation, any statement about scale or volume limits, and any mention of how routing numbers are assigned.
